subject: Procurement calendar orchestration for deal pulses
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement calendar sync: delivery windows for AtlasAI deal

Marissa —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Per our internal manufacturing schedule, the earliest tranche we can commit for the SKU line in the quote is a 14–18 week lead time from receipt of a confirmed PO and initial deposit. We can split deliveries across two shipments (70% / 30%) but need the split defined at PO.

Key limits:
- 14–18 weeks lead time (standard channel)
- Partial-shipment fee if split deviates more than 10% from the stated split
- Customs hold times are outside our guarantee (we recommend DDP to shorten delays)

I've attached the formal quote for your records (Zephyr_Quote_Redwood_2026Q4.pdf). If you can share the expected onramp dates for the deal and any committed windows, we can hold manufacturing slots conditional on a 30% deposit.

Also: we can provide a tentative manufacturing slot hold if Redwood can provide a forecasted tranche schedule by Oct 12 — otherwise we'll release the tentative hold Oct 20.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Liam O'Neal
Senior Sales Manager, Zephyr OEM
liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com

Attachment: Zephyr_Quote_Redwood_2026Q4.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement calendar sync: delivery windows for AtlasAI deal

Liam —

Thanks, appreciate the clarity. A few quick items from our side so we can lock a mutual action plan:

1) AtlasAI has requested a soft onramp at the start of Q1 (target week of Jan 12) with full ramp by Feb 15. Can you confirm if the 14–18 week lead time maps to those dates if PO is issued mid-Oct?

2) On partial shipments: AtlasAI prefers 60/40 split. Can you confirm whether the partial-shipment fee applies to that split? Also please confirm DDP pricing delta for shipments to US west coast ports.

3) Cloud-burst/backfill: we'll likely need an interim cloud-burst arrangement to cover the first 6 weeks if hardware is late — looping in Karthik to propose capacity staging.

I've attached a mutual action plan template (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_ATL-2026-027.xlsx) with proposed milestones — please populate the manufacturing delivery dates and deposit terms where you can. Also attaching a PO template from our procurement team for reference.

Marissa
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_ATL-2026-027.xlsx; PO_Template_Redwood.docx

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement calendar sync: delivery windows for AtlasAI deal

Marissa / Karthik —

Confirming: if Redwood issues PO by Oct 15 with 30% deposit, manufacturing start target is Oct 19, which yields earliest shipments between Feb 1–Mar 1 (14–18 weeks). That aligns with AtlasAI's Jan/Feb cadence only if we can move the PO to the earlier side (Oct 8–12) — otherwise shipment slips into late Feb.

Partial shipments: 60/40 is OK, but the partial-shipment fee does apply — 1.5% of tranche value if the split deviates >10% from planned. DDP to West coast: add $1,200 per unit to the base price (detailed in the attached quote).

We can provisionally hold a manufacturing slot through Oct 20 if you submit a forecast. If Redwood needs a firm hold beyond Oct 20, we need a binding LOI or a non-returnable deposit to reserve capacity.

I'll fill in the delivery windows on the mutual action plan and send back by EOD Oct 2.

Cheers,
Liam

> On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 09:12 AM Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com> wrote:
> > Marissa —
> > 
> > Thanks again for the conversation earlier...

Attachment referenced: Zephyr_Quote_Redwood_2026Q4.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement calendar sync: delivery windows for AtlasAI deal

Liam / Marissa —

Thanks — a couple operational clarifications from the Dedicated Capacity side:

- If AtlasAI's hard ramp date is Feb 15, we should plan a staggered tranche strategy: first tranche 40% to enable validation and smoke tests, second tranche 60% to hit peak throughput. That minimizes downtime risk.

- For the 6-week bridge, Redwood's Dedicated team can provision reserved cloud-burst capacity with a negotiated uplift rate. Sophie from CloudBackfill (cc'd below) can provide an offer for immediate capacity that mirrors the target GPU type. Sophie, can you confirm inventory and lead times for short-term bursts?

- On procurement terms: recommend we ask Zephyr for a 10-day firm window on tentative slots once we deliver a forecast, plus a staged deposit schedule (30% on PO, 30% at manufacturing start, 40% before final shipment). This reduces Redwood/AtlasAI exposure to partial-shipment penalties.

Ben — can you confirm commercial flexibility on DDP delta and whether we can absorb part of the partial-shipment fee as a credit to AtlasAI to keep the deal economics intact?

Karthik Iyer
Director, Dedicated Capacity, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

> On Thu, Oct 1, 2026 at 08:20 AM Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com> wrote:
> > Confirming: if Redwood issues PO by Oct 15 with 30% deposit...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@zephyr-oem.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement calendar sync: delivery windows for AtlasAI deal

Team —

We can provide the following commercial posture to keep AtlasAI on target for the Jan/Feb onramp:

- Redwood will absorb up to 50% of the DDP delta for the first tranche (cap $45k) if AtlasAI signs the PO and deposit by Oct 12. This reduces the immediate landed cost and incentivizes earlier PO.

- On partial-shipment fee: Redwood can offer a one-time credit equal to 0.75% of tranche value if AtlasAI commits to the 60/40 split in the mutual action plan. The remaining 0.75% is to be borne by AtlasAI.

- We will commit to bridging capacity via CloudBackfill for up to 6 weeks. Sophie (cc) — please send a short capacity offer with pricing and GPU match matrix.

Marissa — please confirm if you can get AtlasAI to accelerate the PO to Oct 12 and I'll prepare an internal commercial approval note. Liam — if you can mark the tentative slot hold until Oct 20 and confirm deposit cadence, we can align procurement.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of OEM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Phone: +1 650-555-0133

---
Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@cloudbackfill.io> (on chain) provided capacity note inline and via separate message: "CloudBackfill can provide up to 32 GPUs (matching Zephyr A100-equivalent) on 24-hour spin-up terms for up to 6 weeks; day-rate and setup in separate quote."
